flagged.title: Opposition to the Reformation: More, Fisher and Barton
flagged.reason: The video highlights the statute as the 'Treason Act of 1535' in both the slide heading and narration, teaching the wrong date for a key statutory term examined on the specification (the Treason Act 1534).

mark_affecting.quote: Treason Act of 1535... Enter the Treason Act of 1535, another essential key term for you.
